item.title: For The First Time Ever, Honda Isn't Offering A Manual Gearbox In The Philippines Anymore
item.description: Throughout the decades, Honda is known commonly for its driver-centric character and central to that tenet is a slick manual gearbox. Well, here’s some sad news for all you Honda fans and enthusiasts out there to greet 2026: Honda Cars Philippines has phased out it throughout its local line-up.Read More »
